summary: canon-gate.md and the CHANGELOG say 'an agent cannot widen' the scopes, true only for an edit after the approval (POLICY_APPROVAL_STALE). An agent can narrow code_scopes before the chore is approved and `canon brief approve` records the policy's approval in the same call (verified: 'policy approval recorded too'), so the human's one answer covers scopes they were not shown. Mitigation exists (status chore line and gate advisory chore_code_scopes name the exempted keys); say it in the guide, or show the code_scopes in the approval prompt. Not a defect of the rule. Symlinks are not followed (a symlink app/corelink -> ../core: a core edit exempts app, the link path itself is a change), consistent with the documented 'scope narrower than the real dependencies'.
